speaker: john_heminges
text: Thirty-eight shillings the share. I am entering it as a share. I am not opening your coffer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it a share. Easter week brings the best share since February. I am not adding it to an old count, and I am not stating one.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thirty-eight. I heard you. I am not asking what the afternoon did wrong.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The faults stay in the afternoon. They are not a line in the book.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I heard thirty-eight. I do not need a gross, John. A share is a share.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A share is a share. I played this afternoon. I am not naming the part.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Nor am I naming mine. The number is enough, and then I am done with speeches about it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, thirty-eight shillings the share. Easter week. I have written the item. I have not written a balance.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then the book can shut. I played, and I am not offering a speech about how.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut it. Received is the word. Thirty-eight shillings, and no new total under it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You said the week, not the day. I will remember which word you chose.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The week is the word. February is the comparison. I am not decorating it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. The Rose's titles were this morning. None of their sums are in this book, because I do not know them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And you will not guess them. A guess is a false line.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I have no guess. I have thirty-eight shillings and a thirst.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Keep the thirst. If a cake comes later, it is not this item.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A cake is not this item. This item is the share.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then we are agreed. Thirty-eight shillings the share. The book is shut.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Shut, and witnessed. I saw the figure. I am not making a second sum out of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not. Apiece was Thursday. A share is today. They are not the same arithmetic.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thursday can stay Thursday. I was not the man with the baskets.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The baskets were Thursday. They are not needed to witness a share.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then they are not called. The share is witnessed by the men in this room.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Three of us besides you. That is enough witness for thirty-eight shillings.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Enough. I am done with the book.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Done. Easter week. Thirty-eight shillings. Nothing else on the line.
